Description: Routes each stream to its own configured primary (and optional shadow) inference model behind one batched input/output
Runs a primary and an optional shadow model per stream and can combine both outputs into one batched buffer (unified-batch) for A/B comparison
Supports runtime model swap and stream-routing changes through the DeepStream REST/control-message interface without pipeline reconstruction
Automatically distributes streams beyond a model instance's per-model batch cap onto additional same-model shard instances
